# Research Twin repository instructions

Before planning or editing, open and read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It is the canonical shared
instruction file for this repository and applies to every task. Follow its linked product plan,
architecture, decision records, contribution workflow, and validation requirements.

Do not maintain a separate policy or roadmap in this file. If AGENTS.md or a required linked document
cannot be loaded, report that limitation and request access before implementing. Repository
instructions do not override the coding tool's higher-priority safety or operating instructions.
